# File

Manage the files in the Object Store. `osapi dsl endpoint get --name file` shows
the same.

## Endpoint group

|             |                                      |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------ |
| Name        | file                                 |
| Description | Manage the files in the Object Store |
| Area        | objectstore                          |

### Methods (6)

| NAME   | VERB   | PATH                       | PERMISSION | OPERATION ID     |
| ------ | ------ | -------------------------- | ---------- | ---------------- |
| list   | GET    | /api/file                  | file:read  | GetFiles         |
| upload | POST   | /api/file                  | file:write | PostFile         |
| get    | GET    | /api/file/&#123;name&#125; | file:read  | GetFileByName    |
| update | PUT    | /api/file/&#123;name&#125; | file:write | PutFileByName    |
| delete | DELETE | /api/file/&#123;name&#125; | file:write | DeleteFileByName |
| stale  | GET    | /api/file/stale            | file:read  | GetFileStale     |
